description: Na₄CO₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.59 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.54 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (2.22 Å) and one longer (2.44 Å) Na-O bond length. C is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.44 Å) and two longer (1.47 Å) C-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to five Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to five Na and one C atom.
